weapons.passive_effect_en: When Mahmut uses his Ultimate, increases his ATK by 15% for 2 turns and grants the ally with the lowest HP a shield equal to 60% of Mahmut's DEF for 2 turns.

weapons.passive_name_en: The Hour Between Bells — Oath Echo
weapons.passive_effect_en: When Fadyme uses her Ultimate, grants all allies Sanctuary for 2 turns and grants the ally with the lowest Focus 15 Focus.
When Kera Voss uses her Ultimate, increases her ATK by 15% for 2 turns and inflicts Burn on the enemy with the highest ATK for 2 turns.
When Brin Alder uses her Ultimate, grants all Front Row allies Stoneguard for 2 turns and increases Brin's DEF by 15% for 2 turns.
When Nixie Vale uses her Ultimate, increases her Speed by 15% for 2 turns and arms her next attack to deal 20% more damage.

weapons.passive_name_en: Lantern of the Last Vigil — Oath Echo
weapons.passive_effect_en: When Sister Aveline uses her Ultimate, applies Regeneration equal to 35% of her ATK for 2 turns to all allies and cleanses 1 debuff from the ally with the lowest HP.

weapons.passive_name_en: Quietus at the Broken Bell — Oath Echo
weapons.passive_effect_en: When Sable Wren uses her Ultimate, increases her ATK by 20% for 2 turns and gains 20 Focus.
When Tilda Fen uses her Ultimate, grants all allies Dry Ward for 2 turns and heals the ally with the lowest HP for 50% of Tilda's ATK.
When Rikka Ember uses her Ultimate, grants her a shield equal to 80% of her ATK for 2 turns and increases her ATK by 15% for 2 turns.
When Mirel Quill uses her Ultimate, reduces all allies' skill cooldowns by 1 turn and increases all allies' ATK by 10% for 2 turns.
When Odelia Pike uses her Ultimate, inflicts Fracture and Soaked on the enemy with the highest ATK for 2 turns.

weapons.passive_name_en: A Song Kept in Brass — Oath Echo
weapons.passive_effect_en: When Pippa Bell uses her Ultimate, increases all allies' Speed by 12% for 2 turns and grants the ally with the lowest Focus 15 Focus.
When Nara Vell uses her Ultimate, grants all allies a shield equal to 70% of Nara's DEF for 2 turns and grants all Front Row allies Stoneguard for 2 turns.

weapons.passive_name_en: The Name Beneath Stone — Oath Echo
weapons.passive_effect_en: When Clem Marr uses his Ultimate, inflicts Dread on all enemies for 2 turns and grants all allies Dawnward for 2 turns.

weapons.passive_name_en: Mirror of the Last Hour — Oath Echo
weapons.passive_effect_en: When Vespera Wisp uses her Ultimate, increases her ATK by 20% for 2 turns and inflicts Decay on all enemies for 2 turns.
When Hana Birch uses her Ultimate, inflicts Fracture on all Front Row enemies for 2 turns and increases Hana's Speed by 15% for 2 turns.
When Thistle Roe uses her Ultimate, applies Regeneration equal to 30% of her ATK for 2 turns to all allies and increases all allies' Speed by 10% for 2 turns.
When Iona Mist uses her Ultimate, grants all allies a shield equal to 60% of her ATK for 2 turns and grants all allies Sanctuary for 2 turns.
When Jori Flint uses his Ultimate, grants himself a shield equal to 90% of his DEF for 2 turns and inflicts Burn on all Front Row enemies for 2 turns.

weapons.passive_name_en: March Without a Banner — Oath Echo
weapons.passive_effect_en: When Marek Vane uses his Ultimate, delays the enemy with the highest ATK's next action gauge by 15% and increases all Front Row allies' DEF by 15% for 2 turns.
When Garrick Cinder uses his Ultimate, increases his ATK by 20% for 2 turns and grants himself Stoneguard for 2 turns.
When Corbin Locke uses his Ultimate, grants all Front Row allies a shield equal to 80% of Corbin's DEF for 2 turns and inflicts Fracture on all Front Row enemies for 2 turns.
When Cassian Thorne uses his Ultimate, grants all allies Dawnward for 2 turns and heals the ally with the lowest HP for 60% of Cassian's DEF.
When Dorian Kesk uses his Ultimate, inflicts Decay on all enemies for 2 turns and increases his Speed by 15% for 2 turns.
When Rowan Reed uses his Ultimate, cleanses 1 debuff from all allies and grants the ally with the lowest HP Sanctuary for 2 turns.
